# Bodyscapes — Nick Brand

> Bodyscapes is the fine-art photography brand of Nick Brand, a Sydney photographer with 20+ years' experience.
> The work: black-and-white "bodyscapes" — the human form abstracted into landscape (skin, light, line, texture).
> It is abstract and tasteful fine art, NOT nude, boudoir or glamour photography.
> Each work is a strictly limited edition of 15, printed on framed canvas in custom sizes, with a certificate of
> authenticity. Sold to collectors, interior designers, architects and corporate clients. Priced from AUD $1,700,
> by size and frame. Based in Sydney, Australia; delivery Australia-wide and worldwide.
